verdict.line: You lose if you stand still at 2 stacks of K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) and eat the pull into his W (Path Maker) stun, but you win almost every trade where you poke from outside Hallowed Mist's edge and make him walk into you.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's whole kit is about closing distance and locking you down — Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks to a pull, W (Path Maker) stuns, R (All Out) displaces you through walls — but all three require him to physically reach you. Your W (Hallowed Mist) makes you untargetable to anyone outside the mist, which directly denies that engage. Deny it and you out-poke him for free with Q's true-damage center hits and E's on-hit resets; get caught at range-zero with 2 Q stacks up and he chains straight into a stun.

theirWindow.when: He has 2 Ntofo Strikes stacks and W/R up
theirWindow.what: He can fire the Q shockwave pull into an immediate W (Path Maker) stun, or level 6+ flip you through a wall with R (All Out) and go all-in with boosted damage and healing. Don't stand in his Q line at 2 stacks — back off a step and make him commit E (Footwork) just to close the gap.

yourWindow.when: His E (Footwork) and W (Path Maker) are both down
yourWindow.what: He has no dash, no shield, and no stun available, so step up and land Q (Snip Snip!) center snips for true damage, then E (Skip 'n Slash) in for the attack-speed/range window — hitting anything during it partially refunds E's cooldown so you can chain it again almost immediately.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 100% pick rate in this matchup at 48.4% win over 31 games — the extra sustain matters since K'Sante's Q poke and auto-trades chip you down early.

boots.why: 66.7% win over 12 games — reduces the sting of his Q auto-attack trades and Footwork-enabled stick, since he's an AA-reliant physical damage threat.

core.why: First core item in the measured build path, gives the AP scaling and sustain to win the early trade window.
Second item in the path — bonus damage against the shielded target state punishes him leaning on Footwork's shield mid-fight.
Caps the core path, turning your Q/E poke and R needle casts into real burst once he's forced to engage.

you're leaning on E (Skip 'n Slash) on-hit resets to keep chipping him down

runes.keystoneWhy: 44.4% win rate, 29% pick — the stacking adaptive force rewards the extended trades you're forced into once W (Hallowed Mist) denies his burst engage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite (51.6% pick) secures kills off your Q/E poke once you've won a trade sequence; Flash+Teleport (32.3% pick) is the safer pick if you'd rather scale and siege with your late-game burst instead of forcing early skirmishes.

playing.title: Hold W until he commits
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only protects you from enemies outside it, so don't pre-cast it on cooldown — save it for the moment he dashes in with E (Footwork) or charges W (Path Maker) so he's forced to walk into the mist to even reach you.

playing.title: Track his Q stack visually
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and fires a pull shockwave at 2 stacks — if you see one stack land, respect the second hit and don't stand in a straight line from him.

playing.title: Center your Q snips on him
playing.detail: Q (Snip Snip!) deals true damage only to units in the center of the cone, so walk your snips so he's the one eating true damage every cast, not just clipped by the edge.

playing.title: Chain E off hit-confirms
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's cooldown partially refunds on a hit during the attack-speed window, so only dash in when you're confident you'll connect — a whiffed E leaves you without your reset for a full cooldown.

playing.title: Respect level 6 R threat windows
playing.detail: All Out knocks you through walls and then buffs his damage, healing, and ability cooldowns for its duration — don't fight him near a wall at full HP bar parity once he hits 6, since the knockback alone can reposition the whole trade.

playing.title: Punish empty W/E cooldowns
playing.detail: Path Maker (14-10s cooldown) and Footwork (10-8s cooldown) are his only gap-close and stun tools — if you track both on cooldown, that's your window to walk up and farm true-damage snips risk-free.

playing.title: Don't facetank post-6 all-ins
playing.detail: Once he's All Out, his abilities transform and his Q cooldown shortens — if he's already in that state, disengage with E's dash rather than trying to out-trade him at point-blank range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG. The mechanical reads on cooldowns, stack thresholds, and timing windows are our own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.
